hooks.name: new-control-scaffold
hooks.description: When a control file is saved, generate whatever the skeleton needs for it: connectors, fixtures, contract tests and casebook rows.

action.prompt: A Night Audit control file was just saved. Read it and the connector interface in skeleton/. For every ledger source it names that has no connector yet: write the connector class (read-only), a recorded fixture under the app's tests/fixtures, and a contract test that loads the fixture through the connector. Then run `uv run pytest -q` for that app and report the result. Do not modify the skeleton, and do not read casebook/heldout.
